lines.text: Save us, O LORD our God,
and gather us from the nations,
that we may give thanks to Your holy name,
that we may glory in Your praise.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel,

pictures.scene: Charles-Émile Jacque, Shepherdess and Sheep, Fontainebleau — the flock brought in around the shepherdess and down to the water, save us and gather us from the nations
pictures.name: pd_jacque_verzamel

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Last Judgement — Christ enthroned in the blue mandorla with the saints and angels around Him with their hands joined, that we may glory in Your praise
pictures.name: pd_angelico_lof

pictures.scene: Andrei Rublev, The Trinity — the three seated at the one table around the cup, from everlasting to everlasting, and let all the people say, Amen
pictures.name: pd_rublev_eeuwig
